name: Themofy Dynamic Tags for Elementor
author: themofy

sections.description:
Elementor’s dynamic tags let a widget field pull its value from your site (the post title, the featured image, a custom field…) instead of typed-in text. The free version of Elementor includes the dynamic tags system but no tags. This plugin provides them.

Click the dynamic tags icon (the stacked-disks icon) next to any supported field — headings, text, buttons, links, images, galleries, colors, numbers — and pick a tag.

Works in the classic Elementor editor and in Elementor 4 atomic (V4) widgets.

Post
Post Title, Post Excerpt, Post URL, Post ID, Post Date, Post Time, Post Terms, Reading Time, Featured Image, Featured Image Data, Post Attached Images (gallery)

Archive
Archive Title, Archive Description, Archive URL

Site
Site Title, Site Tagline, Site URL, Site Logo, Page Title, Current Date Time, Request Parameter (URL parameter or query var), Shortcode

Author
Author Name, Author Info, Author URL, Author Profile Picture

User (the logged-in visitor)
User Info, User Profile Picture

Comments
Comments Number, Comments URL

Custom Fields
Custom Field (text, link, number or color), Custom Field Image, Custom Field Gallery. Read any custom field (Meta Box, Pods, plain WordPress meta…) from the current post, the current archive term, the post author, the logged-in user or an ACF options page: type the meta key.

ACF (shown only when Advanced Custom Fields is active)
ACF Field, ACF URL, ACF Image, ACF Gallery. Just pick the field from the list, as in Elementor Pro. The value is found automatically: options page fields from their options page, other fields from the current post (inside loops too) or the archive’s term or author. Values come out ready to use: images, links, choice labels, true / false, related posts, terms and users, dates in your return format and Group sub fields. In the editor, loop and single templates preview the latest post that has a value.

Links
Contact URL (email, phone, SMS, WhatsApp, Telegram, Messenger, Viber, Skype, Google Maps, Waze), Internal URL (post, term, author or media file by ID), Login / Logout URL

WooCommerce (shown only when WooCommerce is active)
Product Title, Product Price (with sale & ranges, regular, sale or a plain number), Product Sale Badge (shown only while on sale, with an optional discount percentage), Product Short Description, Product SKU, Product Stock, Product Rating (average, counts or stars), Product Attribute (e.g. Color), Product Data (weight, dimensions, total sales, type), Product Image, Product Gallery, Product Category Image, Add To Cart URL, Store Page URL (shop, cart, checkout, my account, terms), Cart Info (item count, subtotal, total).

Every product tag works with the current product or a product picked by ID — handy for landing pages that feature one product.

Any tag can be switched off under Settings → Themofy Dynamic Tags.

Themofy Dynamic Tags is an independent plugin. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Elementor Ltd. or WooCommerce.
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress admin go to Plugins → Add New, search for “Themofy Dynamic Tags” and click Install Now. Or upload the plugin zip under Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate Themofy Dynamic Tags for Elementor. Elementor must be installed and active.
  3. Edit a page with Elementor and click the dynamic tags icon next to a field.
sections.faq:
Do I need Elementor Pro?

No. If Elementor Pro is active as well, both sets of tags are listed; you can switch off duplicates under Settings → Themofy Dynamic Tags.

Why is a tag empty in the editor?

The editor previews tags against the page you are editing. Archive tags only have a value on archive pages, User tags only for logged-in visitors, and Custom Field tags only when the field has a value on that page.

My ACF field shows nothing

Use the tags in the ACF group (ACF Field, ACF URL, ACF Image, ACF Gallery) and pick the field from the list; there is no source to choose. A field group key (it starts with group_) is not a field and never has a value. A field also needs a value on the post being shown: if it is empty there, the tag is empty, or shows its Fallback (under Advanced).

Why can’t the Custom Field tag show some keys?

Keys that look like passwords, tokens, secrets, sessions or capabilities are always blocked so they cannot be printed on a public page. The “ACF Options Page” source only reads ACF options fields (options_{field_name}), never arbitrary site options. Developers can adjust the block list with the themofy_dt_is_sensitive_meta_key filter.

Does the Cart Info count update when something is added to the cart?

Yes. The tag loads WooCommerce’s cart fragments script, which refreshes the count, subtotal and total after an AJAX add-to-cart and when a cached page is loaded.

What does the Add To Cart URL do for variable products?

Variable and grouped products need options chosen first, so the link goes to the product page instead. External products link to their external URL. Out-of-stock products link to the product page.

My shortcode’s form or iframe is stripped

Shortcode output is limited to the HTML allowed in post content. Developers can allow more tags (such as form, input or iframe) with the themofy_dt_shortcode_allowed_html filter.

How do I add my own tag?

Create a class that extends \Elementor\Core\DynamicTags\Tag (text output) or \Elementor\Core\DynamicTags\Data_Tag (URLs, images, galleries) and add its class name through the themofy_dt_tag_classes filter. It is registered with the others and listed on the settings page. Use one of the plugin’s groups, e.g. \ThemofyDynamicTags\Plugin::GROUP_SITE.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • New: ACF tag group (ACF Field, ACF URL, ACF Image, ACF Gallery), shown when Advanced Custom Fields is active. Pick the field from a list, as in Elementor Pro; the value is found automatically, with no source to choose.
  • New: ACF values come out ready to use: images, links, choice labels, true / false, related posts, terms and users, dates and Group sub fields.
  • New: options page fields are read from their options page, including options pages with their own post ID.
  • New: in the Elementor editor, loop and single templates preview the latest post that has the field’s value.
  • Improved: the Custom Field tags also format ACF values when given an ACF field name or field key (field_…).
  • Fixed: the Custom Field Gallery tag shows a single image field as a one-image gallery.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
